evidence: A user likes Plezy as an open-source Plex UI alternative but must press back after wake; a reply corrects the spelling to Plezy. It is a client replacement, not a server-security fix.

evidence_sources.author: HaloZero
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use Pleezy which has been a nice open source alternative to the Plex UI. The only issue we've had is that on wake, you have to press back once to do anything else.

source_story_title: Plex vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild to drop a cryptominer
